issue.title: sase-core-rs floor is 0.21.0 but the glossary PyO3 bindings ship in the unreleased 0.21.1
issue.description:
Found by epic sase-hq's land agent while landing the project-local glossary epic. Caused by sase-hq: this is the standard post-release floor bump, but master is currently red on CI until it happens.

REPRODUCTION (definitive, run today at master 7b473c789):
  uv venv --python 3.12 /tmp/pub-core-smoke
  uv pip install --python /tmp/pub-core-smoke/bin/python 'sase-core-rs==0.21.0'
  /tmp/pub-core-smoke/bin/python tools/check_sase_core_rs_bindings
  -> 'sase_core_rs 0.21.0 is missing 3 of 264 required binding(s): compile_glossary_catalog, glossary_catalog, glossary_validate'
That is exactly what CI's 'published-core-minimum-smoke' lane runs (.github/workflows/ci.yml, 'Check every required binding exists in the published minimum'), so that lane fails on master right now.

ROOT CAUSE: src/sase/core/glossary_facade.py (added by 544e98a19, phase sase-hq.1) calls require_rust_binding('glossary_validate'), ('glossary_catalog'), and ('compile_glossary_catalog'). Those bindings come from sase-core commits f6a29d3 ('feat(core): add glossary catalog domain') and 943af9b ('feat(xprompt-lsp): add glossary semantics'), which landed on sase-core master AFTER the v0.21.0 release tag -- 'git ls-tree -r v0.21.0 | grep glossary' is empty. pyproject.toml still declares 'sase-core-rs>=0.21.0,<0.22.0' and uv.lock pins 0.21.0. PyPI latest for sase-core-rs is 0.21.0.

WHY IT WAS NOT CAUGHT LOCALLY OR BY 'just check': dev installs build sase_core_rs from the linked sase-core checkout, which is at master and has the bindings, and the locally built wheel still reports version 0.21.0. So both the version comparison in tools/validate_sase_core_rs and 'just check-full' pass while the published wheel of the same version number does not have the symbols. This is the same skew class as sase-h0 and the crash documented in tools/check_sase_core_rs_bindings' module docstring.

IMPACT: on any environment that resolves sase-core-rs from the package index (published installs, the CI smoke lane), 'sase memory init' fails on a project with a glossary -- load_project_glossary_memory catches the AttributeError and returns 'failed to validate glossary' -- and ACE/LSP glossary semantics silently degrade to nothing.

BLOCKED ON: sase-core release-plz PR #98 ('chore: release v0.21.1', branch release-plz-2026-08-08T22-28-23Z) must be merged and the wheel published. Its changelog already lists both glossary commits. Nothing in this repo can proceed before that; bumping the floor now would make 'uv lock' unresolvable.

SCOPE once v0.21.1 is on PyPI: raise pyproject.toml from 'sase-core-rs>=0.21.0,<0.22.0' to '>=0.21.1,<0.22.0', refresh uv.lock, and re-run tools/check_sase_core_rs_bindings against the published 0.21.1 plus 'just check-full'. Same shape as prior floor bumps 491579083, 7bdeee08e, and 25be8cc68. Do not hand-edit any release-plz-owned version field in sase-core.
